title: Hourly Auto-Dig: Chatham House location semantics and Latin America Programme update
summary: Dataset-first Chatham House pass adds a source-bounded registered organizational address, preserves the absence of explicit headquarters wording, records the 2026 formal establishment of the Latin America Programme, and queues exact headquarters/programme-date resolution.

data.research_question: What defensible public organizational location can be attached to Chatham House, and what material current organizational update has appeared since the July 31 source-roster capture?
data.method: Refreshed current main, recent hourly merges, open work, operating documentation, executable v0.9.0 schema, topic manifest, source-dataset manifest, and selected organization through the GitHub connector. Enumerated the 54-entry global dataset/topic universe as 19 source roster manifests, 27 existing dig roots, and 8 topic views. Excluded the previous-three successful hourly datasets boao-forum-public-roster, graphika, and fed. Sorted the remaining 51 candidates lexicographically and selected index seed mod 51 with the recorded 64-bit seed; this selected chatham-house-public-roster. Its current manifest exposes one canonical organization target, starintel:org:chatham-house. Reviewed first-party Chatham House contact and organizational pages for public location semantics, then searched current first-party/news surfaces for material updates. Recorded the Royal Institute's registered address without silently relabeling it headquarters. In current organizational news, recorded Chatham House's statement that the Latin America Initiative, founded in 2019, was formally established as a research programme earlier in 2026; exact establishment date remains unresolved.
classification_rules: Dataset stage samples datasets/topics, not rows, so large datasets do not gain probability from record count.
Previous-three successful hourly datasets are excluded when at least four candidates exist.
Previous-three dominant geographies China/Beijing-Hainan, New York, and Washington, D.C. are avoided when alternatives exist.
Registered address, main trading address, office, venue, and explicit headquarters designation remain distinct location semantics.
No coordinates are created without a defensible source or geocoder-backed result.
Current organizational news is ingested only when it adds a material event or change; routine commentary is not treated as an organizational event.

findings.selection_algorithm: sort complete dataset/topic pool lexicographically; remove hard previous-three dataset exclusions; choose eligible_pool[seed mod len(eligible_pool)]; then choose within selected dataset using its canonical target_options/document_ids

findings.result: First-party Chatham House pages identify 10 St James's Square, London SW1Y 4LE as the registered address of the Royal Institute of International Affairs; the reviewed pages do not explicitly call it headquarters, so the record remains registered organizational address rather than an invented HQ assertion.

Chatham House's current Latin America Programme and launch pages state that the Latin America Initiative, founded in 2019, was formally established as a research programme earlier in 2026. This is a material organizational update; the exact formal-establishment date is not stated on the reviewed pages.
